excluded.nonplanar_command_both_default: Native scripted SelectBy rejects Both; it leaves Angle active. This is not evidence for the local combined criterion.
excluded.nonplanar_command_explicit_distance: Inline Distance=value enters a face getter without admitting that numeric value; a later split option is rejected and the command cancels.
excluded.nonplanar_command_distance_separate: Distance was entered while Angle was active. It invokes the separate Distance measurement command, not a triangulation option.
excluded.nonplanar_command_combined_name: Native scripted SelectBy rejects DistanceAndAngle; it leaves Angle active.
excluded.nonplanar_command_first_selection: All already advances the native single-mesh picker. The extra Enter accepted the command before the intended options, which were rejected after it ended.

limits: Native scripted command inputs and exact saved source archives are independent of output geometry. Replays compare raw mesh records, stored normals/UV/colors, surviving n-gons, identity, attributes, groups, object table order, selection and document Undo/Redo.

Fresh native scripted defaults are SelectBy=Distance, Distance=0, Angle=0 and ShortestDiagonal. Bare SelectBy toggles Distance and Angle. Active numeric thresholds use a separate response. Native area choices are MinimumArea and MaximumArea; legacy MinimizeArea/MaximizeArea and Mode aliases remain local extensions.

Accepted options persist across documents and Undo/Redo within a registry. Cancellation preserves accepted settings. Success clears selection, skips non-mesh sources, moves processed meshes to the object table end and records Undo even on unchanged meshes. Input geometry and tolerance are pinned while local options are staged.

The application shares one staged mesh conversion getter with QuadrangulateMesh. Invalid numeric updates are atomic; cancellation preserves redo. Native saved-script postselection uses All, not physical mouse input. This record does not qualify face threshold sampling; nonplanar-sample-qualification.json covers that separate workflow. Dialogs/live previews, spinner controls, restricted objects, grips, multi-mesh processing order, extreme values and comparative performance remain unqualified.

Five discovery workflows are explicitly excluded because Rhino rejected an option, invoked a different measurement command or accepted before the intended options. Corrected postselection captures omit the extra Enter after All. The local combined criterion uses the separately qualified SDK path; no native scripted combined-mode parity is claimed. A failed IronPython import retains its six requested workflows, host log and frozen producers with zero qualified geometry.
